responsibility: Declares the borrow-check diagnostic adapter that turns Polonius output for one Rust function into frontend errors. It defines the BorrowCheckerDiagnostics class, the per-function inputs it consumes—HIR function, BIR function, collected facts, and the move/loan/subset error relations—and the helper interface for mapping Polonius points, loans, and origins back to source locations and labeled diagnostics, serving as the public contract for the reporting logic implemented in the companion source file.
same_name_distinction: Within the rust-borrow-checker-diagnostics pair, this .h file is the declaration/interface side: it defines the BorrowCheckerDiagnostics class, constructor, stored inputs, and helper signatures, whereas the companion .cc file implements the actual borrow-check error reporting behavior.
